TRUNCATE TABLE BUSC.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE_DELTA;

WITH SRC AS	
(	SELECT
	HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(ACID,BANK_ID,TRAN_DATE_BAL,TRAN_DATE_TOT_TRAN,VALUE_DATE_BAL,VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN,END_EOD_DATE,LCHG_USER_ID,LCHG_TIME,RCRE_USER_ID,RCRE_TIME,TS_CNT,EAB_CRNCY_CODE,EOD_DATE))
	AS HASHROW,
	ACID
	,BANK_ID,EOD_DATE,END_EOD_DATE,LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME,12),8) AS FILE_NAME
FROM (	SELECT [ACID]
,ISNULL(convert(datetime2,[EOD_DATE]),'1900-01-01T00:00:00.000') AS EOD_DATE
,convert(numeric(25,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([TRAN_DATE_BAL],' ',''),''),0)) as TRAN_DATE_BAL
,convert(numeric(25,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([TRAN_DATE_TOT_TRAN],' ',''),''),0)) as TRAN_DATE_TOT_TRAN
,convert(numeric(25,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([VALUE_DATE_BAL],' ',''),''),0)) as VALUE_DATE_BAL
,convert(numeric(25,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN],' ',''),''),0)) as VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN
,ISNULL(convert(datetime2,[END_EOD_DATE]),'1900-01-01T00:00:00.000') AS END_EOD_DATE
,[LCHG_USER_ID]
,ISNULL(convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(LCHG_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')),'1900-01-01T00:00:00.000') as [LCHG_TIME]
,[RCRE_USER_ID]
,ISNULL(convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(RCRE_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')),'1900-01-01T00:00:00.000') as [RCRE_TIME]
,convert(numeric(5,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([TS_CNT],' ',''),''),0)) as TS_CNT
,[EAB_CRNCY_CODE]
,[BANK_ID]
,1 as isActive
,1 as isLatest
,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as [BNK_CODE]
,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as [SOURCE_CODE]
,[FILE_NAME]
,convert(datetime2,[insert_dttm]) as insert_dttm
FROM [D360].[STG_DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE_20231020]
where H = 'D' 
) A ), TGT AS	
(	SELECT
	HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(ACID,BANK_ID,TRAN_DATE_BAL,TRAN_DATE_TOT_TRAN,VALUE_DATE_BAL,VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN,END_EOD_DATE,LCHG_USER_ID,LCHG_TIME,RCRE_USER_ID,RCRE_TIME,TS_CNT,EAB_CRNCY_CODE,EOD_DATE))
	AS HASHROW,
	ACID
	,BANK_ID,EOD_DATE
FROM	BUSC.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE
--WHERE	isLatest = 1
)	
INSERT INTO BUSC.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE_DELTA (SRC_HR,TGT_HR,ACID,BANK_ID,EOD_DATE,END_EOD_DATE,isActive,isLatest,RECORD_STATUS)
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.ACID,TGT.ACID) AS ACID
	,ISNULL(SRC.BANK_ID,TGT.BANK_ID) AS BANK_ID
	,ISNULL(SRC.EOD_DATE,TGT.EOD_DATE) AS EOD_DATE
	,SRC.END_EOD_DATE
	,CASE WHEN SRC.ACID IS NULL AND SRC.BANK_ID IS NULL AND SRC.EOD_DATE IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS isActive
	,CASE WHEN SRC.ACID IS NULL AND SRC.BANK_ID IS NULL AND SRC.EOD_DATE IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS isLatest
	,CASE
	    WHEN TGT.ACID IS NULL AND TGT.BANK_ID IS NULL AND TGT.EOD_DATE IS NULL  --AND SRC.FILE_NAME >=  CONVERT(VARCHAR,SRC.EOD_DATE,112)  
            THEN 'INSERT'
        WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	    ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM	SRC
LEFT JOIN	TGT
ON	SRC.ACID = TGT.ACID
AND	SRC.BANK_ID = TGT.BANK_ID
AND	SRC.EOD_DATE = TGT.EOD_DATE
	
WHERE	(	
TGT.ACID IS NULL
OR	TGT.BANK_ID IS NULL
OR	TGT.EOD_DATE IS NULL
	)
OR	SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW;


UPDATE TGT
SET END_EOD_DATE = DELTA.END_EOD_DATE
FROM BUSC.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE TGT
JOIN BUSC.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.ACID = TGT.ACID
AND DELTA.BANK_ID = TGT.BANK_ID
AND DELTA.EOD_DATE = TGT.EOD_DATE
WHERE TGT.END_EOD_DATE = '20991231' AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE';


Update BUSC.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE set isActive = 0, isLatest = 0 where  concat(ACID,BANK_ID,EOD_DATE,'') in (select concat(ACID,BANK_ID,EOD_DATE,'')  from BUSC.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE_DELTA where record_status = 'DELETE') and isLatest = 1;
Update BUSC.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE set isLatest = 0  where  concat(ACID,BANK_ID,EOD_DATE,'')  in (select concat(ACID,BANK_ID,EOD_DATE,'')  from BUSC.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE_DELTA where record_status = 'UPDATE') and isLatest = 1;

AND ACID = 'PA10113728'

TRUNCATE TABLE BUSC.DEP_TBLDEPAGGRBALANCES_DELTA;

WITH SRC AS	
(	SELECT 
	HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(BANK_ID,ACID,PREVIOUS_CURRBAL,PREVIOUS_CLEARBAL,CURRENT_EOD_DATE,ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL,ACCUMULATED_CLEARBAL))
	AS HASHROW,
	ACID
	,BANK_ID
FROM (	SELECT [BANK_ID] ,[ACID] ,convert(numeric(18,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([PREVIOUS_CURRBAL],' ',''),''),0)) as PREVIOUS_CURRBAL ,convert(numeric(18,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([PREVIOUS_CLEARBAL],' ',''),''),0)) as PREVIOUS_CLEARBAL ,ISNULL(convert(datetime2,[CURRENT_EOD_DATE]),'1900-01-01T00:00:00.000') as CURRENT_EOD_DATE ,convert(numeric(18,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL],' ',''),''),0)) as ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL ,convert(numeric(18,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([ACCUMULATED_CLEARBAL],' ',''),''),0)) as ACCUMULATED_CLEARBAL ,1 as isActive ,1 as isLatest ,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as [BNK_CODE] ,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as [SOURCE_CODE] ,[FILE_NAME] ,convert(datetime2,[insert_dttm]) as insert_dttm FROM [D360].[STG_DEP_TBLDEPAGGRBALANCES] where H = 'D'
) A ), TGT AS	
(	SELECT 
	HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(BANK_ID,ACID,PREVIOUS_CURRBAL,PREVIOUS_CLEARBAL,CURRENT_EOD_DATE,ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL,ACCUMULATED_CLEARBAL))
	AS HASHROW,
	ACID
	,BANK_ID
FROM	BUSC.DEP_TBLDEPAGGRBALANCES
WHERE	isLatest = 1
)	
INSERT INTO BUSC.DEP_TBLDEPAGGRBALANCES_DELTA (SRC_HR,TGT_HR,ACID,BANK_ID,isActive,isLatest,RECORD_STATUS)
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.ACID,TGT.ACID) AS ACID
	,ISNULL(SRC.BANK_ID,TGT.BANK_ID) AS BANK_ID
	
	,CASE WHEN SRC.BANK_ID IS NULL AND SRC.ACID IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS isActive
	,CASE WHEN SRC.BANK_ID IS NULL AND SRC.ACID IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS isLatest
	,CASE
		WHEN SRC.ACID IN (SELECT ACID FROM BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER WHERE DEL_FLG = 'Y') THEN 'DELETE'
	    WHEN TGT.BANK_ID IS NULL AND TGT.ACID IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
	ELSE 'UPDATE' END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN	TGT
ON	SRC.ACID = TGT.ACID
AND	SRC.BANK_ID = TGT.BANK_ID
	
WHERE	(

TGT.ACID IS NULL
OR	TGT.BANK_ID IS NULL
	)
OR	SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW
